Probe startup verifies fixed local genesis before contract-state queries and binds original contract addresses, full loan/swap build receipt digests and source manifest digest. Full native/gen-generated decode is delegated to the accepted reader and loader.

Each capture has explicit canonical finalized anchor; anchors can differ as node advances. Scope promises neither atomic cross-contract observation nor authenticated state proof nor no intervening actions after an anchor.

Method errors mapped by transport to RPC_RESPONSE leave support UNKNOWN when no successful capture exists. A completed first snapshot may establish observed availability and remain retained if the second fails. No unsupported-method claim is inferred from a generic transport error.
